title: Plumeform contact split (v2)
description: On paper: at the left an eyebrow, heavy heading and slate paragraph, a set of pill choices (the chosen one solid ink, the others soft) and a short teal-dotted list that changes with the choice; at the right a glass form panel in mint fog with labelled rounded fields, a textarea, a full-width ink pill button and a small note. The list and the message label swap in with a quick fade when the choice changes; everything rises into view.
notes: needs JavaScript for the choice pills (hydrate: visible); without it the first choice shows
the form posts to action with the field names you give; wire it to your own endpoint
name: plumeform-v2-contact
